title: Prepaid expense rollforward from invoices and service dates
prompt: Build a prepaid expense rollforward from invoices and contractual service dates. Calculate current-month amortization and remaining balances.

setup.q: Below what amount is an invoice expensed when paid rather than set up as a prepaid or an asset?
How are prepaids amortized (straight-line by month, by day, half-month convention)?
Which ledger account (or accounts) holds prepaid expenses?

inputs.name: Vendor invoices and service agreements for prepaid items

steps: pull the prepaid account ledger for the period and the invoices behind each addition: Dime's documents first, then a document request
read the service period from each invoice or agreement; an invoice below the threshold is expensed and listed, not scheduled
build the schedule per item: cost, service start and end, monthly amortization under the stated method; run rollforward (opening, additions, amortization, closing) to the Detail sheet
propose a prepaid schedule per new item (tier A with a stated service period, tier C when none) and the month's amortization entry (tier A) debiting the expense and crediting prepaid
tie the schedule closing to the prepaid account balance; list every difference item by item

done.text: The Detail sheet rolls forward per prepaid item: opening plus additions less amortization equals closing on every row and the totals row equals the column sums
No two proposals schedule or amortize the same vendor, amount and period
Every proposed amortization entry balances to the penny
Every exception row cites the invoice id or the ledger transaction id and the schedule line
prepaid-rollforward.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Each item's service period comes from the invoice or agreement and is quoted; an item with no stated service period is a question, not a schedule

tierRules.when: the invoice or agreement states the service period
the month's amortization from a schedule with a stated service period under the stated method
